raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an unverified assumption that the Celtic ruler was Tiberius Claudius Cogidubnus and even claimed he was “born around AD 43,” which is not supported by credible sources and misaligns with the timeline (Cogidubnus was a client king after the AD 43 Roman invasion). This early misidentification and timeline error led the Planner to conflate the conquest context (later also invoking Julius Caesar and the Roman Republic), risking an incorrect attribution of the conquering entity, which should be the Roman Empire.
